description: Check whether a specific Florida property can build an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU / backyard cottage / granny flat). Returns the parcel's zoning code, jurisdiction (city vs. unincorporated county), an eligibility verdict, and the local ADU rules (max size, owner-occupancy, short-term-rental limits). Use this whenever a user asks if an ADU, garage apartment, or in-law suite is allowed at a Florida address — do not guess, Florida has no statewide ADU law and rules vary parcel by parcel.

address.description: Full Florida street address, e.g. '123 Main St, Tampa, FL 33602'. City and state improve accuracy.

name: check_adu_eligibility
